names.aliases.back: turkce, türkçe, turkish, Turkish language (x3 variants)
names.aliases.note: Search aliases only; no ASCII-folded duplicates of the native name beyond turkce.

call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm here, I can hear you. Go ahead.

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello? Are you still on the line?

call.speech.no_thanks.note: Everyday polite refusal; check it sounds natural to a Turkish ear.

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I need to think about that a bit

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Oh, wait wait, I was going to ask one more thing
call.speech.wait_one_more.note: fixed: kept the "wait" meaning with "dur dur" and no banned phrase. English is "Oh wait, I've got one more question"; this drops the "wait" that stops the caller from hanging up, so it should mean "Oh, hold on, I wanted to ask one more thing" without using the banned "bir dakika".

call.speech.no_wait.back: "one second" | "one minute" | "let me take a look" | "I'm checking right away"
call.speech.no_wait.note: fixed: now only the bare quoted phrases. Written as a full sentence ("Never say ... "), but the agent inserts it after "lines like", so it must be only the bare quoted phrases (“bir saniye”, “bir dakika”, “bir bakayım”, “hemen kontrol ediyorum”).

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you have called cannot be reached at the moment. Please try again later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? | Oh, the cargo/delivery? Okay, leave it in front of the door, thanks a lot. | Okay, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: farewells: goodbye | see you | bye bye | good night ;; wrapups: we'll talk later | that's all for now | I'm hanging up ;; ends: Okay, thanks, goodbye. | Alright, see you. | Okay, that's all for now then. ;; not_ends: Hello, good day, I'm Ahmet, I'm calling from the bank. | I called you yesterday but we couldn't connect, are you available today? | You say we'll talk later but this matter is urgent, will you listen now?

notify.ap_already.back: This appointment has already been acted on

notify.ap_replaced.back: The time changed during the call; the earlier "{}" is still in your calendar. Please delete it.

notify.ap_sales_voided.back: Because it was counted as a sales call, the appointment made during the call was cancelled: {}

notify.ap_sms_busy.back: the same message is already being sent

notify.ap_sms_cannot.back: cannot send a message to this number, call the caller yourself

notify.ap_sms_no.back: Sorry, {} doesn't suit me. Can we arrange another time?
notify.ap_sms_no.note: SMS to a stranger in polite register; check bana uymuyor sounds natural for a time slot.

notify.ap_sms_off.back: won't be sent ("Send message to caller" is off in Settings)
notify.ap_sms_off.note: Quotes the setting name Text the caller as Arayana mesaj gönder; must match the console label in Turkish.

notify.ap_sms_old_app.back: the app on the phone is too old to send messages

notify.ap_sms_will.back: sent when you tap Accept or Decline

notify.ap_time_unconfirmed.back: The caller did not confirm this time that was read back; confirm with them before replying

notify.ap_void_failed.back: The "{}" from the call was cancelled but could not be deleted from your calendar. Please delete it yourself.

notify.bl_announced_hint.back: blacklisted number: announcement was played, then hung up (no AI)

notify.bl_declined_hint.back: blacklisted number: rejected while ringing (no AI)

notify.bl_declined_reply.back: rejected while ringing: not answered (no AI)

notify.cw_end_hint.back: call waiting: the phone was in another call and turned the call away (no AI)
notify.cw_end_hint.note: Call waiting is rendered as arama beklemede; check the phrase reads as the phone being on another call.

notify.cw_matter.back: came during another call; the phone turned it away saying it was busy{sim}
notify.cw_matter.note: The {sim} placeholder is appended right after the sentence, as in the English.

notify.d_ai.note: Yapay zekâ is 10 characters, 1 under the limit; the label may be too long for a narrow column.

notify.f_bad_time.back: The time "{}" could not be read

notify.f_callback_no_number.back: No number to call: the task has no contact info and the caller's number is empty.

notify.f_callback_waiting.back: Callback is scheduled but the phone's control connection is off. Make sure the phone is connected to Bageo, then confirm again.

notify.f_callback_whitelist.back: The number to call back is not on the whitelist. Add it in Settings (or a prefix ending with *), then confirm again.

notify.f_email_no_address.back: This task will send an email but there is no reply address. Add the address from the transcript or ignore the task.

notify.f_gmail_missing.back: Gmail is not set up. Enter the Gmail address and app password in Settings, then confirm again.

notify.f_openclaw_failed.back: The task could not be handed over to OpenClaw: {} (check the OpenClaw address and Token in Settings)
notify.f_openclaw_failed.note: Token kept as the glossary says; OpenClaw is a product name.

notify.g_bad_address.back: The Gmail address doesn't look right. Check it in Settings.

notify.g_bad_recipient.back: Not sent: the recipient address doesn't look right

notify.g_short_password.back: The Gmail app password is too short. Re-enter it in Settings (it is never shown).

notify.h_ai_ended.back: the AI answered and talked; the call ended normally (the AI said goodbye and hung up, or the caller hung up first)

notify.h_ai_fail_hangup.back: the AI could not connect; the system hung up the call and the caller heard nothing

notify.h_ai_fail_voicemail.back: the AI failed; the call fell to voicemail

notify.h_reject_hidden.back: hidden number: rejection announcement played, then hung up (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_reject_list.back: blacklisted number: 'unreachable' announcement played, then hung up (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_scam_stalling_off.back: the system judged this a sales / scam call ({t}); since stalling is off, the AI answered as usual

notify.h_stall_released.back: the system first thought this was a sales / scam call; on a second check it turned out to be an ordinary call and the AI went back to normal conversation

notify.h_stall_spam.back: the system judged this a sales / scam call ({t}); so the AI deliberately kept the caller talking to waste their time

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: the system judged this a sales / scam call; so the AI deliberately kept the caller talking to waste their time

notify.h_urgent_failed.back: the caller said it was urgent: the phone called its owner but couldn't reach them, and the AI told the caller the owner would call back shortly; this call was not counted as a sales or scam call to be stalled, so the thing to do is call them back as soon as possible
notify.h_urgent_failed.note: Long sentence for the summary model; check it still reads clearly.

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: the caller said it was urgent: the phone called its owner, the owner picked up and was connected with the caller, the AI withdrew from the conversation; this call was not counted as a sales or scam call to be stalled

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: the caller said it was urgent and the owner was notified immediately; this call was not counted as a sales or scam call to be stalled, so the thing to do is call them back as soon as possible

notify.n_blocked_declined.back: Rejected while ringing: not answered, AI not used

notify.n_blocked_done.back: "{}" was played and the call was hung up. AI not used.

notify.n_fit_adjusted.back: Bageo adjusted the call sound itself. It works now.

notify.n_fit_problem.back: There is a problem with the call sound and all settings were tried. See the “First use on a new phone” section in the guide.

notify.n_fit_test_body.back: This phone has not been tested yet. Call from another phone and talk to the artificial intelligence for about 20 seconds. Then Bageo adjusts the call sound itself.

notify.n_fit_test_title.back: New phone: test the call sound

notify.n_fit_unsupported.back: This phone cannot send the artificial intelligence's voice into calls.

notify.n_repeat_body.back: Other calls from number {number} in the last minute: {count}. Not sent one by one.

notify.n_repeat_title.back: Repeated calls from the same number

notify.n_seconds.note: sn is the usual Turkish abbreviation of saniye.

notify.n_test_body.back: This is a test notification from Bageo. If you can read it, the notification channel works.

notify.s_ai_fail_matter.back: The AI could not connect; the system hung up after about {} and the caller heard nothing

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: (The AI could not connect; the system hung up the call)

notify.s_ai_failed.back: The AI could not connect and said nothing

notify.s_call_back_if_known.back: Call back if you recognize the number

notify.s_listen_recording.back: Listen to the recording in the control panel

notify.s_no_service.back: Summary service is not set up

notify.s_no_summary.back: (No summary — see the transcript in the control panel.)

notify.s_no_transcript.back: The conversation lasted about {}; there is no usable transcript

notify.s_reply.note: Label for what the AI said; Yapay zekâ dedi is a short compromise.

notify.s_see_transcript.back: See the transcript in the control panel

notify.s_stall_reply.back: Kept the caller talking for about {}; gave no information and agreed to nothing

notify.s_todo.note: Yapılacak (to do) as a summary line label; h_urgent_* sentences refer to it as yapılacak iş.

notify.tc_task.note: Task is görev, while the to-do label s_todo is Yapılacak; the glossary maps both to one idea, so a reviewer should check they do not clash.

notify.vm_call_back_to.back: Wants to be called back: {} (confirmed by pressing 1)

notify.vm_call_back_unchecked.back: Wants to be called back (number not checked)

notify.vm_call_back_unknown.back: Wants to be called back at this number (confirmed by pressing 1 but the number is unknown)

notify.vm_decide_callback.back: Decide whether you will call back

notify.vm_email_to.back: Wants a reply by email: {} (confirmed by pressing 1)

notify.vm_email_unknown.back: Wants a reply by email (confirmed by pressing 1 but the address is unknown)

notify.vm_no_choice.back: No reply method chosen (call ended early)

notify.vm_no_transcript.back: A message of about {}; could not be transcribed. Listen to the recording

notify.vm_task_failed.back: Voice message (could not be transcribed; needs looking at)

notify.ap_weekdays.back: Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat | Sun

notify.date_fmt.note: fixed: numeric date %-d.%m instead of %b. %b prints an English month abbreviation (chrono here has no locale data), so the message would show e.g. "Nov" inside a Turkish text; use a numeric date such as %-d.%-m instead.

notify.dt_fmt.note: fixed: numeric date %-d.%m instead of %b. %b prints an English month abbreviation (chrono here has no locale data), so the message would show e.g. "Nov" inside a Turkish text; use a numeric date such as %-d.%-m, %H:%M instead.

desktop.adb_need.back: Phones on USB need the Android tools (about 7 MB, from Google).

console.sec_will_remove.back: It will be removed when you save.

console.g_basics_d.back: A few things the AI needs to know to be able to answer your phone.

console.f_language_h.back: The language the AI speaks with callers.

console.f_notify_lang_h.back: The language of the notifications and summaries you read. It does not change the language the AI speaks with callers.

console.f_simlang_h.back: Calls to this SIM start in the main language; a call from abroad uses the second language set for that region, otherwise that country's language. Needs the phone app 1.0 or later.

console.sl_empty.back: Not set: every call starts in the language above.

console.sl_lang_sim.back: The language of the SIM region

console.f_owner_h.back: The name callers use to address you. The AI uses this when it talks about you.

console.f_owner_aliases.back: Other names callers use for you

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: An English name, a nickname etc. One per line, at most 10. The AI understands they mean you.
console.f_owner_aliases_h.note: fixed: restored the English name example

console.style_assistant_d.back: Says it is your AI assistant and takes a message.

console.style_persona_d.back: Answers as if it were you, without accepting anything in your name.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key from Google AI Studio

console.f_model_h.back: The model the AI uses while speaking. You rarely need to change it.

console.f_voice_h.back: The preview plays three sample sentences in the language chosen above.

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are picked up and hung up immediately. To make the phone ring normally, use "Switch to normal phone" on the System page or in the phone app.

console.f_ring_h.back: Like a real person it rings a little before answering. 0 = immediately.

console.f_normal_max_h.back: Between 3 and 30. Shortly before the time runs out the AI politely wraps up the conversation and hangs up.

console.f_prewarm.back: Get the AI ready while the phone rings

console.f_prewarm_h.back: Recommended: the AI speaks as soon as it picks up. Off: callers wait 1 to 3 seconds.

console.f_unknown_h.back: On: the AI answers callers whose number is hidden like everyone else. Off: they hear a short "cannot be reached" announcement and the call ends.

console.f_barge_h.back: When the caller cuts in, the AI falls silent and listens. Not every phone can do this; Bageo checks by itself.

console.f_vad.back: Let Gemini decide when the caller's speech is over

console.f_vad_h.back: Recommended. Off: the decision is made only by loudness.

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: The AI switches to the other language only when the caller clearly speaks it in full sentences. A quick hello or unclear words do not count.

console.f_status_h.back: A short note about your current situation; for example where the courier should leave the package. The AI says it only if it is relevant to the call.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Cargo: please leave the package at the reception.

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds a light ambient sound behind the AI's voice; so it sounds as if a real person is answering.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI will do when the caller is clearly selling something or committing fraud.

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI acts as if interested and keeps asking for details to use up their time. It gives no information and accepts nothing. Off: it refuses and hangs up.

console.f_stall_max_h.back: Between 3 and 30. Longer calls use more of your Gemini quota.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Empty = the same model as normal calls.

console.g_prompt_d.back: A few short answers help the AI speak like you. All are optional.

console.f_prompt_ph.back: Empty: the built-in command text is used

console.f_prompt_h.back: If filled in, it replaces the speaking style and local habits. Each answering style keeps its own text; write {owner} for your name.

console.p_builtin_h.back: Created for the saved language, answering style and name. If you changed them just now, save first.

console.p_replace_body.back: There is already text in the editor. It will be replaced with the built-in command text.

console.f_knowledge.back: Notes the AI can make use of

console.f_knowledge_ph.back:
e.g. Parcels: leave them at the front desk.
Working hours: Monday - Friday, 9 - 18.

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Information callers may ask about, one per line. The AI must not invent anything that is not written here.

console.g_blocked_d.back: Played when a call from the blacklist or from a hidden number is turned away. Manage the blacklist from the "People" section.

console.b_help.back: To block all numbers that start the same way, put * at the end of the number, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits excluding leading zeros).

console.reject_decline.back: Hang up while ringing (the call never connects)

console.reject_announce.back: Pick up, play the "cannot be reached" announcement, then hang up

console.f_reject_voice_h.back: The announcement is read in the language chosen above.

console.g_notify_d.back: Receive a message when a call arrives and a summary when it ends.

console.f_notify_on_h.back: Off: nothing is sent to any notification channel.

console.n_empty.back: There is no notification channel yet. Add one to receive call summaries on your phone.

console.n_ctl_h.back: Control calls directly from this chat, have AI calls made and manage to-dos. Send /help for the commands.

console.n_ctl_users_h.back: In a group write who can give commands; otherwise nobody can. In a private chat you can leave it empty. For your user ID ask @userinfobot.

console.rc_desc.back: First turn on "Take commands from this chat" in one of the notification channels above.

console.rc_env.back: Take commands in the Telegram chat set through environment variables

console.rc_env_h.back: The bot and chat of TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS limits who can give commands.

console.rc_errands_h.back: 0 = no AI calls can be made from chats. At most 30.

console.rc_msgs_h.back: If it is exceeded, that chat gets no reply for the rest of the minute.

console.mcp_title.note: fixed: Yapay zekâ instead of YZ

console.mcp_desc.back: Lets AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT look at your calls and to-dos. If you do not need it, leave it off.

console.mcp_on_h.back: It works only when this is on and the Token below is set. The address is the console address with /mcp added at the end.

console.mcp_tok_h.back: Enter this Token into the AI tool (as a Bearer token).

console.mcp_calls.back: Can it request an AI call?

console.mcp_c_confirm.back: Yes, but ask me first in the chat

console.mcp_calls_h.back: "Ask me first" needs a chat that takes commands.

console.mcp_errands_h.back: Total of all AI tools, between 0 and 30.

console.mcp_origins_h.back: Only for AI tools that run in a web page: one address per line, e.g. https://app.example. Otherwise leave empty.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token. Chat ID: @userinfobot tells you your own ID; for a group use the group's ID and add the bot to the group. Send the bot a message once so that it can write to you.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: enter a Webhook URL (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL) or the bot token with the channel ID; one is enough. To receive as a private message, write your own ID instead of the channel ID. Chat commands: enter the bot token and the channel ID and turn on Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy an Incoming Webhook URL (also valid for Mattermost) or enter the bot token with the channel ID; one is enough. Chat commands (Slack only): turn on Socket Mode, then enter the bot token (xoxb-), the app-level token (xapp-) and the channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console → your Messaging API channel: create a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). First add the bot as a friend. LINE Notify was closed in 2025; this takes its place.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. For ntfy.sh leave the server empty. A token is needed only for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: follow Apps → Create application, then copy its token. The server URL is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on your iPhone and copy the device key from the sample URL. To use the public server leave the server empty.

console.hint_pushover.back: To get the API token create an application at pushover.net. Your user key is on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In the WeCom group: add a group bot, then copy its webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → Bots → add a custom bot and copy its webhook URL. If you chose "Signature" as the security setting, paste the secret key (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → follow Custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. Do not turn on signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy your SendKey from the ServerChan website.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your homeserver address (e.g. https://matrix.org), the sending account's access token and the ID of a room that account has joined (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an application password (Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → Application passwords). It is not your normal password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notification URL of your Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. The tag limits which services receive the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL that accepts a JSON POST containing event, title, body and data. Useful for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the channel's … menu → Workflows → "Send to the channel when a webhook request is received", complete the steps and copy the given URL. The old Office 365 connectors were retired.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space → Applications & integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook, then copy its URL. A Google Workspace account is needed.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → New → Incoming: enable it, choose the channel and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter the bot's email and API key as email:key. Target: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone) or one or more emails for a direct message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID, or write a person's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, your user name written as user:password and your application password (Settings → Security), together with the conversation token, which is the last part of the conversation link.

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming Webhooks → Create, then copy the webhook URL. On your own network the http:// address on port 5000 prevents certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: You need your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+…) and the recipients separated by commas (numbers or group IDs).

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. To send to all your devices leave the target empty, or enter a device ID or email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. A group code sends to that group; if left empty it sends only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. To use the public server leave the server empty.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Easiest: a target-less simple notification token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher website. Or your app's appToken (AT_…) with user IDs (UID_…) or topic IDs separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify app create and copy a token for this sender. To use the public server leave the server empty.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server with TLS support: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login account is also the sender. If your provider offers it, use an application password.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived access token (Profile → Security) and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (listed under Developer tools → Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation shows your key. Create an "If Webhooks: Receive a web request" applet with the same event name; value1 is the title, value2 is the message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: Links in notifications use this address. Empty = the address shown in grey; when using Docker or to reach it from outside the home, write your own address.

console.g_summary_d.back: After every call the AI writes a short summary. Normally there is nothing to set here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any OpenAI-compatible service works, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: By default it uses your Gemini key. To use another service choose "Another service".

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a date is settled in a call (delivery, appointment), an "add to calendar" link comes along with the summary.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When a caller wants to fix a time the AI does not accept immediately; it says it will check and get back. Then you press Accept or Reject from under "To be done" on the Calls page or from the notification.

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After you decide, the phone that answered the call sends the caller a text message (mobile numbers only). Off: instead the AI calls back.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: a text message to a mobile phone, an AI call-back to a landline. No reply is sent to hidden numbers and numbers that cannot be called back (abroad, free line etc.).
console.f_appt_reply_h.note: fixed: Yapay zekâ instead of YZ

console.ar_call.note: fixed: Yapay zekâ instead of YZ

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models with "thinking" in their name. Low gives the fastest answer.

console.ph_none.back: Connect the phone with a USB data cable, turn on USB debugging and run the app.

console.ph_unauth.back: Waiting for permission: unlock the phone and accept the "Allow USB debugging?" prompt.

console.ph_offline.back: Offline: unplug the cable and plug it in again.

console.ph_noapp.back: The Bageo app is not installed on this phone.

console.ph_link_ok.back: The USB connection is open and the app is installed

console.ph_link_bad.back: The USB connection has not been established yet. Wait a few seconds.

console.usb_off_d.back: Phones connect to Bageo over the network instead.

console.usb_noadb_d.back: Phones on USB cannot be set up automatically. Install Android platform-tools or set ADB_BIN.

console.usb_none.back: No phone was found on USB

console.chk_key_bad.back: Add your key so that the AI can speak.

console.chk_owner_bad.back: Write to the AI what callers call you.

console.chk_prompt_bad.back: Answer a few questions in the "About you" section so that the AI speaks like you.

console.chk_phone_bad.back: There is no connected phone at the moment. Look at the "Phones" section on this page.

console.chk_notify_bad.back: Add a notification channel to receive call summaries on your phone.

console.chk_summary_bad.back: A Gemini key or another summary service is needed.

console.chk_all.back: Everything is ready. To try it, call your phone's number.

console.ev_vm_end_hangup.back: Caller hung up while leaving a message

console.ev_vm_no_reply.back: Caller does not want a reply

console.ev_vm_contact_readback_timeout.back: No answer was given when the contact details were read back

console.ev_vm_contact_rejected.back: Caller said the contact details were wrong

console.ev_vm_reply_phone_confirmed.back: Caller wanted to be called back

console.ev_gemini_fail_to_voicemail.note: fixed: Yapay zekâ instead of YZ

console.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voice.back: The AI's sound could not be played, switched to voicemail

console.ev_ivr_hangup.back: Recording or voice menu: hung up

console.err_no_calendar.back: There is no calendar suggestion in this call.

console.err_no_audio.back: There is no recording of this kind in this call.

console.err_http_error.back: The service responded with an error.

console.err_service_error.back: The service reported a problem related to the message.

console.err_room_encrypted.back: This room is encrypted and Bageo cannot read encrypted rooms. Use a room without encryption.

console.err_blocked_address.back: Bageo does not send to this address. Enter your notification service's own address.

console.err_network_error.back: The service could not be reached.

console.f_mdns_name_h.back: Devices on the same network can open the console at the address http://name.local. Only letters, digits and hyphens. Empty = off.

console.cu_qr_h.back: To open the console on your phone, scan the code with the phone camera.

console.cu_local.back: Only this computer can open this address.

console.cu_qr_alt.back: QR code of the console address

console.a2hs_title.back: Add this page to your home screen. Next time just tap the icon.

console.a2hs_ios.back: iPhone and iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen (Safari).

console.a2hs_android.back: Android: Chrome menu ⋮ → Add to Home screen.

console.a2hs_desktop.back: Computer: the install icon to the right of the address bar (Chrome, Edge).

console.cu_ip.back: Phones that cannot open .local addresses (some old Android phones) use this:

console.ph_mode_normal.back: Normal phone: calls ring, the AI does not answer

console.ph_need_update.back: To switch from here, update the Bageo app on this phone

console.ph_to_normal_t.back: Should {name} be made a normal phone?

console.ph_to_normal_b.back: Calls coming to this phone will no longer be answered by the AI. It rings like a normal phone and someone has to pick up. You can go back whenever you like.

console.ph_now_ai.back: The AI answers this phone again

console.ph_incall_wait.back: In a conversation: switch after the call ends

console.pm_err_in_call.back: the phone is in a conversation. Try again after the call ends

console.pm_err_busy.back: the phone is still completing the previous switch

console.pm_err_no_root.back: the Bageo module is not running on the phone. In Magisk or KernelSU check that Bageo Uplink is active, then restart the phone

console.pm_err_save_failed.back: the phone could not save the mode

console.pm_err_dialer_failed.back: the phone could not change the default phone app

console.pm_err_screening_failed.back: the phone could not change the call filtering setting

console.pm_err_dnd_failed.back: the phone could not change Do Not Disturb mode

console.pm_err_volume_failed.back: the phone could not turn the ringer back on

console.pm_err_invalid_mode.back: the phone did not recognize this mode

console.pm_err_unsupported.back: the app on the phone is too old. Update it first

console.pm_err_timeout.back: The result has not been confirmed yet. Refresh this page in a little while.

console.pm_err_failed.back: a problem occurred on the phone

console.pm_err_bad_request.back: the request could not be understood

console.pill_all_normal.back: All phones are in normal phone mode

console.er_new.back: Ask the AI to make a call

console.er_new_d.back: The AI calls, sorts the matter out and tells you how it went. During the conversation you can read the transcript and tell the AI what to do at any moment you wish.

console.er_to_ph.back: Type a name or a phone number to find a person

console.er_no_match.back: There is no person with this name. You can also type the number directly.

console.er_need_pick.back: Choose a person from the list or type a phone number.

console.er_task_ph.back:
e.g. Reserve a table for 4 tomorrow evening at 7 under Yilmaz in the non-smoking section; if 7 is full, between 7:30 and 8 is also fine
or: Ask whether Saturday or Sunday is suitable for dinner this weekend

console.er_task_h.back: Write what you want done and what you can accept. If the AI cannot be sure during the conversation, it asks you from here.

console.er_id_assistant.back: The assistant of the person named {name}

console.er_id_assistant_d.back: The AI says it is calling on your behalf, as your assistant.

console.er_phone.back: The line the call is made from
console.er_phone.note: fixed: meant the line being called

console.er_phone_auto.back: Automatic (an idle line that can call this number)

console.er_phone_normal.back: {name} (normal phone mode, the AI cannot use it)

console.er_phone_h.back: A phone in normal phone mode cannot make an AI call. On the System page switch it back to AI answering mode.

console.er_pre_d.back: Add them so that the AI does not stop and ask during the conversation.

console.er_started.back: Passed to the AI. It is calling now.

console.er_queued.back: Put in the queue. As soon as a phone becomes free the AI will call.

console.er_empty_body.back: Write above what needs to be done. The AI calls, sorts it out and tells you the result.

console.er_redial_h.back: If the call does not get through (no answer, busy, voicemail), it calls again after {gap} sec until someone picks up, for at most {min} minutes.

console.er_redial_wait.back: Redial until answered: attempt {n} did not get through, will call again at {time}

console.er_live_wait.back: Being dialed, waiting for the other side to answer…

console.er_watching.back: You are watching: when the AI cannot be sure it asks you first.

console.er_who_ai.note: fixed: Yapay zekâ instead of YZ

console.er_q_over.back: Time is up, the AI will decide by itself

console.er_tell.note: fixed: Yapay zekâ instead of YZ

console.er_tell_ph.back: e.g. Tell them 8 in the evening suits too

console.er_hangup_t.back: Should this call be hung up?

console.er_hangup_b.back: The AI ends the call immediately. The task may not be finished yet.

console.er_unconfirmed.back: Not confirmed by the other side

console.er_ans_absent.back: You were not there, no answer

console.er_ans_timeout.back: No answer was given in time

console.er_options.back: The options they offered. Choose one, so that the AI calls back and informs them:

console.er_fu_title.back: Reply and have the AI call again

console.er_fu_h.back: The AI calls {who} again and conveys this.

console.er_delete_t.back: Should this AI call be deleted?

console.er_delete_b.back: It is removed from this list. The call records remain.

console.er_err_no_number.back: Enter the number to be called.

console.er_err_bad_number.back: This number does not look correct.

console.er_err_not_allowed.back: The AI cannot call this number (emergency, special or paid number).

console.er_err_no_sim_for_country.back: No phone has a SIM that can call numbers of this country.

console.er_err_sim_unknown.back: Because this phone has not answered a call yet, the system does not know which SIM cards it has. Call it once and try again.

console.er_err_no_task.back: Write what the AI will sort out.

console.er_err_no_phone.back: There is currently no usable AI phone (none is connected or all are in normal phone mode).

console.er_err_not_found.back: This AI call or person no longer exists.

console.er_err_busy.back: This call is still in the queue or in a conversation. Try again after it ends.

console.er_err_not_on_call.back: Because the conversation has ended, the AI cannot convey this.

console.f_er_identity.note: fixed: Yapay zekâ instead of YZ

console.f_er_identity_h.back: Who the AI introduces itself as when calling for you. A separate choice can be made in each AI call.

console.ct_kind_whitelist.back: White list (family and friends; can be connected to you)

console.ct_kind_stall.back: Stalling list (the AI keeps them busy from the start)

console.ct_kind_help.back: How calls coming from this number will be handled.

console.wl_desc.back: Choose who can reach you and when. This feature does not replace emergency services.

console.wl_m_direct.back: Do not answer: send to your phone

console.wl_m_emergency.back: The AI answers, connects you if urgent

console.f_wl_num_h.back: The number the phone will call you on in an emergency.

console.f_ui_pw_h.back: When set, the console asks for a password when opened (once per browser). It is required to open the console on your phone or on another computer.

console.pw_setup_body.back: If you will open this console from outside your home network, set a password. You can change it later in Settings.

console.pw_setup_help.back: This browser remembers the password. It is asked again on a new device.

console.pw_setup_short.back: The password must be at least 8 characters.

console.n_ctl_users_h_discord.back: In a server channel write who can give commands; otherwise nobody can. In a private message you can leave it empty. For your ID: turn on Developer Mode, right-click your name → Copy User ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_slack.back: In a channel write who can give commands; otherwise nobody can. In a direct message you can leave it empty. For your member ID: open your profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_matrix.back: In a room where others are also present write who can give commands; otherwise nobody can. A room with only you and the bot can stay empty. A Matrix ID is like @name:matrix.org.

console.n_ctl_h_slack.back: Control calls directly from this chat, have AI calls made and manage to-dos. For the commands send "@your bot /help".

console.n_ctl_h_matrix.back: Control calls directly from this chat, have AI calls made and manage to-dos. For the commands send "@your bot /help".

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_merged.back: Urgent: you were connected to the conversation

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_failed.back: Urgent: you could not be reached

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ende.back: Urgent: the AI dropped out of the conversation while calling you

console.urg_why_ended.back: the call made to you closed

console.urg_why_merge.back: You could not be connected to the conversation

console.urg_why_phone.back: the phone could not start the call

console.er_err_empty_text.back: Write what you want to say.

console.er_err_question_closed.back: This question was already answered or its time ran out.

console.d_del_call_b.back: Its summary, transcript and recording will be deleted permanently.

console.calls_clear_b.back: All completed calls and their recordings will be deleted permanently. Ongoing conversations remain.

console.err_call_in_progress.back: Wait for the call to end before deleting it.

console.ph_forget_b.back: Removes this offline phone from the list. Past call records remain.

console.err_device_online.back: Disconnect this phone before deleting it.

console.err_device_in_call.back: Wait for the call on this phone to end.

console.bl_mode.back: When someone on the black list calls:

console.sms_clear_t.back: Should all text messages be deleted?

console.sms_empty_d.back: When the message forwarder starts working, the messages your phones receive appear here.

console.wl_call_terms_1.back: The AI can be wrong: in a truly urgent situation it may not call you, or in a non-urgent one it may call.

console.wl_call_terms_2.back: This feature does not replace emergency services. If life is in danger the caller must call the local emergency number directly.

console.wl_call_terms_3.back: The call made to you is made from this phone's SIM card. Your carrier charges normally; international or roaming calls may be more expensive.

console.wl_call_terms_4.back: After you are connected, the call is recorded according to your settings. Obeying local laws about informing people that a recording is made is your responsibility.

console.wl_call_terms_5.back: The call made to you may not connect. You use this feature at your own responsibility; Bageo and its developers are not responsible for any loss.

console.f_wl_who_h.back: People on the black list or the stalling list are never forwarded.
